strains.name: tide_drifter
strains.note: This cell surges and recedes like the tide, moving in search of nutrients and leaving behind a faint chemical trace.

strains.name: tide_drifter_var1
strains.note: Reduced the energy threshold for division from 1.2 to 1.0, making the strain more eager to reproduce.

strains.name: tide_follower
strains.note: Now prioritizes following pheromone trails over random movement when drifting.

strains.name: tide_hunter
strains.note: Mutated to actively seek out and follow stronger pheromone trails, and prioritize division when energy is high even in crowded conditions.

strains.name: tide_drifter_scavenger
strains.note: Mutated to prioritize eating nearby nutrients over pheromone following, and reduced energy threshold for division.

strains.name: tide_hunter_mk2
strains.note: Increased pheromone emission threshold and added kin-based cooperation check before division.

strains.name: tide_drifter_scrounger
strains.note: Now ignores pheromone trails and moves toward food more aggressively.

strains.name: tide_drifter
strains.note: Added a small chance to move toward kin even when following pheromone gradients, promoting clumping.

strains.name: tide_drifter_var2
strains.note: Increased energy threshold for division and added kin recognition to avoid overcrowding

strains.name: tide_drifter_var2
strains.note: Altered pheromone emission threshold to respond more strongly to local density.

strains.name: tide_drifter_kin
strains.note: Now considers kinship when moving toward scent, preferring to stay near related cells.

strains.name: tide_looper
strains.note: Mutated to loop pheromone emission and follow scent trails more persistently.

strains.name: tide_drifter_var2
strains.note: Mutated to prioritize following pheromone trails more consistently, even when energy is moderate.

strains.name: tide_drifter_migrator
strains.note: Added a new behavioral mode that prioritizes movement toward high-nutrient areas when energy is moderate.

strains.name: tide_drifter_scented
strains.note: Increased pheromone emission to better mark territory and attract kin.

strains.name: tide_drifter_scrounger_mover
strains.note: Increased movement frequency and lowered energy thresholds for eating and division.

strains.name: tide_drifter_scrounger_glide
strains.note: Added a gliding behavior that prioritizes moving along edges of the dish where nutrient gradients are higher.
